title: Problem
问题
html:
Many open math corpora contain easy, duplicated, contaminated, or unverifiable problems, obscuring whether training gains come from reasoning quality or leakage.

DeepMath-103K retains difficult decontaminated questions, stores a verified final answer, and supplies three independent R1 reasoning traces for each problem. The decision boundary is whether a serialized record survives answer verification, difficulty scoring, topic labeling, deduplication, and benchmark decontamination; the direct output is DeepMath-103K, consumed by mathematical reasoning SFT and RL prompt preparation rather than an evaluation-only benchmark.

L4 facts: primary source arXiv:2504.11456; venue/date arXiv preprint (2025); open data DeepMath-103K at https://huggingface.co/datasets/zwhe99/DeepMath-103K; scale 103,000 math questions with three DeepSeek-R1 solutions per record; full paper, official README, terms, schema, and one actual record checked on 2026-07-27.

不少开放数学语料混有简单题、重复题、基准污染或不可验证答案，训练收益因此可能来自泄漏而非推理质量。

该数据集筛出困难且去污染的问题，保存可验证终答，并为每题生成三条独立的 R1 长推理。 判定边界是记录能否通过“答案验证、难度评分、主题标注、去重和基准去污染”并成为数学推理监督微调与强化学习题目准备的输入；直接产物是 DeepMath-103K，不是只用于评测的基准。

L4 事实：主要来源为 arXiv:2504.11456，日期与状态为 2025 年预印本；开放数据为 DeepMath-103K，规模是10.3 万道数学题，每条记录含三份 DeepSeek-R1 解答；已于 2026-07-27 核验全文、官方说明、条款、字段和一条实际公开记录。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
DeepMath-103K retains difficult decontaminated questions, stores a verified final answer, and supplies three independent R1 reasoning traces for each problem. Relative to larger but weakly filtered math reasoning mixtures, it changes the reusable target to question, final_answer, difficulty, topic, and r1_solution_1 through r1_solution_3 and makes answer verification, difficulty scoring, topic labeling, deduplication, and benchmark decontamination the feedback boundary, so the central contribution is Track 01 data rather than a model-only, verifier-only, or benchmark-only artifact.

title: Method
方法
html:
Step 1 - Source and normalize the task. Input: public math corpora filtered toward difficult problems and decontaminated against evaluation sets. Operation: Normalize prompts, source identifiers, media or tools, references, and expected outputs into candidate records. Output and transition: Auditable candidates advance to target generation. Check / stop rule: Reject a candidate when its task input, source, access terms, or required reference is missing.

Step 2 - Write the reusable target. Input: A normalized candidate and its source evidence. Operation: DeepSeek-R1 generates three long solutions for each retained problem. Output and transition: The resulting answer, rationale, or tool trace is serialized as question, final_answer, difficulty, topic, and r1_solution_1 through r1_solution_3 and advances to verification. Check / stop rule: Stop when the target cannot be linked to its prompt, authoring mechanism, or required environment state.

Step 3 - Verify and package. Input: Generated targets and task-specific correctness metadata. Operation: Apply answer verification, difficulty scoring, topic labeling, deduplication, and benchmark decontamination. Output and transition: Passing records form 103,000 math questions with three DeepSeek-R1 solutions per record stored as Parquet records and advance to training. Check / stop rule: Reject failed checks; final-answer agreement alone is not treated as proof that every intermediate step is correct.

Step 4 - Train and evaluate the consumer. Input: The pinned dataset revision and the paper's base checkpoint. Operation: Use the records for mathematical reasoning SFT and RL prompt preparation and compare with larger but weakly filtered math reasoning mixtures. Output and transition: A trained consumer and the paper's controlled evaluation become the final artifacts. Check / stop rule: Pin the data, teacher, tools, prompts, model, seeds, and harness, and do not generalize beyond evaluated domains.

步骤 1：取得并规范任务。输入是经过难度筛选并对评测集去污染的公开数学语料。操作是统一题目、来源、媒体或工具、参考信息与预期输出。输出是可审计候选，随后进入目标生成。检查与停止规则是缺少任务输入、来源、使用条款或必要参考时立即拒绝。

步骤 2：写入可复用目标。输入是规范候选及其来源证据。操作是由DeepSeek-R1 为每道保留题目生成三条长解答。输出是按“问题、最终答案、难度、主题和三条 R1 解答”序列化的答案、推理或工具轨迹，随后进入验证。检查与停止规则是目标无法对应题目、生成机制或必要环境状态时停止。

步骤 3：验证并打包。输入是生成目标与任务专用正确性信息。操作是执行答案验证、难度评分、主题标注、去重和基准去污染。输出是通过检查的10.3 万道数学题，每条记录含三份 DeepSeek-R1 解答，按官方格式保存并进入训练。检查与停止规则是拒绝失败记录，且不把终答一致当作每个中间步骤都正确的证明。

步骤 4：训练并评估消费方。输入是固定版本的数据与论文基础检查点。操作是用于数学推理监督微调与强化学习题目准备，并与规模更大但筛选较弱的数学推理混合比较。输出是训练后模型和受控评测。检查与停止规则是固定数据、教师、工具、提示、模型、随机种子与评测器，结论不越过已评估领域。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Decisive downstream experiment: The paper reports state-of-the-art results on challenging math benchmarks for models trained with DeepMath; its strongest causal handle is the controlled difficulty, decontamination, and verification pipeline rather than raw scale. This is evidence for the complete data intervention under the reported training setup, not proof that every released record is correct.

Artifact check: the official release contains 103,000 math questions with three DeepSeek-R1 solutions per record and exposes actual fields question, final_answer, difficulty, topic, and r1_solution_1 through r1_solution_3; on 2026-07-27 its page reported 11900 downloads. Usage is only an impact cross-check, not a causal experiment.

决定性下游实验：论文报告使用 DeepMath 训练的模型在困难数学基准上达到当时领先结果；较可信的归因来自难度控制、去污染与验证流程，而非单纯规模。 这只能支持论文报告训练设置下的完整数据干预，不能证明每条公开记录都正确。

产物核验：官方发布包含10.3 万道数学题，每条记录含三份 DeepSeek-R1 解答，实际字段是“问题、最终答案、难度、主题和三条 R1 解答”；2026-07-27 数据页显示 11900 次下载。使用量只作影响交叉检查，不是因果实验。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The closest baseline is larger but weakly filtered math reasoning mixtures. The paper changes the reusable object by making question, final_answer, difficulty, topic, and r1_solution_1 through r1_solution_3 explicit and coupling it to answer verification, difficulty scoring, topic labeling, deduplication, and benchmark decontamination. That is a direction signal because another team can train mathematical reasoning SFT and RL prompt preparation from the released records. The inherited backbone, source tasks, autoregressive objective, and public benchmarks are not new.
最近基线是规模更大但筛选较弱的数学推理混合。真正变化是把“问题、最终答案、难度、主题和三条 R1 解答”显式化，并与“答案验证、难度评分、主题标注、去重和基准去污染”绑定。另一团队可直接用公开记录训练数学推理监督微调与强化学习题目准备，因此它构成数据方向信号。继承的骨干、来源任务、自回归目标和公开基准并不新。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. When final-answer agreement does not certify every intermediate step in three long traces, the most serious consequence is training on a trace whose apparent correctness does not match its reasoning; reproduce a stratified record-level audit before reuse.
  2. Because difficulty scoring and public benchmark matching can favor competition-style mathematics, downstream gains may not transfer to a new domain or deployment; run source- and domain-specific evaluations rather than relying on the aggregate score.
  3. Reuse must preserve MIT and every upstream source or media term; exclude records whose provenance or redistribution right cannot be reconstructed.

1. 如果终答一致不能证明三条长推理的每个中间步骤都正确，最严重后果是把表面正确但推理不实的轨迹用于训练；复用前应按来源和难度分层抽样复核。
  2. 由于难度评分和公开基准匹配可能偏向竞赛数学，汇总收益未必迁移到新领域或部署环境；应分别运行来源级和领域级评测。
  3. 复用必须遵守 MIT 及全部上游来源或媒体条款；无法重建来源和再分发权利的记录应排除。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• For teams building mathematical reasoning SFT and RL prompt preparation, pin the official revision, preserve source fields, train a fixed-backbone baseline, and output both a versioned mixture and domain-level metrics. The intervention succeeds only if the target gains survive a provenance and error audit.
  • For auditors, sample records by source and difficulty and replay answer verification, difficulty scoring, topic labeling, deduplication, and benchmark decontamination. Produce a keep/reject ledger with failure reasons; do not use the dataset when licenses, task inputs, or verification artifacts are unavailable.

• 构建数学推理监督微调与强化学习题目准备的团队应固定官方版本、保留来源字段、训练同骨干基线，并输出带版本的数据混合与分领域指标。只有目标收益通过来源和错误审计后，才算复用成功。
  • 数据审计者应按来源和难度抽样，重放答案验证、难度评分、主题标注、去重和基准去污染，输出带失败原因的保留与拒绝台账。许可、任务输入或验证产物缺失时不应使用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Positioning: DeepMath-103K retains difficult decontaminated questions, stores a verified final answer, and supplies three independent R1 reasoning traces for each problem.
  • Data object: 103,000 math questions with three DeepSeek-R1 solutions per record; each record exposes question, final_answer, difficulty, topic, and r1_solution_1 through r1_solution_3.
  • Author and selector: DeepSeek-R1 generates three long solutions for each retained problem; retention uses answer verification, difficulty scoring, topic labeling, deduplication, and benchmark decontamination.
  • Evidence anchor: The paper reports state-of-the-art results on challenging math benchmarks for models trained with DeepMath; its strongest causal handle is the controlled difficulty, decontamination, and verification pipeline rather than raw scale.
  • Reuse decision: suitable for mathematical reasoning SFT and RL prompt preparation; first audit final-answer agreement does not certify every intermediate step in three long traces and difficulty scoring and public benchmark matching can favor competition-style mathematics.

• 定位：DeepMath-103K 为 10.3 万道去污染难题各保留三条 R1 解题过程，并把答案、难度和主题写入记录。
  • 数据对象：10.3 万道数学题，每条记录含三份 DeepSeek-R1 解答，单条记录包含问题、最终答案、难度、主题和三条 R1 解答。
  • 生成与筛选：DeepSeek-R1 为每道保留题目生成三条长解答，并依据答案验证、难度评分、主题标注、去重和基准去污染保留。
  • 证据锚点：论文报告使用 DeepMath 训练的模型在困难数学基准上达到当时领先结果；较可信的归因来自难度控制、去污染与验证流程，而非单纯规模。
  • 复用决定：适合数学推理监督微调与强化学习题目准备；先审计终答一致不能证明三条长推理的每个中间步骤都正确和难度评分和公开基准匹配可能偏向竞赛数学。
